title: The Spirit and Mission
definition: The Spirit and mission refers to the Holy Spirit's work of sending, empowering, and guiding God's people in Gospel witness.
summary: The Spirit empowers the Church to bear witness to Christ.
christFocus: Jesus promised the Spirit so His disciples would be His witnesses to the nations.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Mission belongs to God, and the Spirit empowers the Church for it. The disciples were told to wait for power from on high before bearing witness.

The Spirit sends, guides, opens doors, gives boldness, and glorifies Christ through Gospel proclamation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many ministries rely on strategy while neglecting spiritual dependence. This doctrine matters because Gospel witness requires the Spirit's power.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray for Spirit-empowered witness. Share the Gospel clearly, depend on God's power, and remember that Christ sends His people by the Spirit.
